summary: deb822_repository options for download targets, marking a source trusted, package types (deb or deb-src), and repository URIs.
questions: How do I add source packages (deb-src) with deb822_repository?
How do I set the repository base URL?
How do I mark a repo as trusted?

answer_card.title: deb822_repository parameters (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `uris`: base URL(s) of the archive
- `types` (default `[deb]`): `deb` and/or `deb-src`
- `trusted`: treat source as trusted
- `targets`: download targets to acquire
